title: 48 Moyola Park, Newcastle, Galway City, H91KWX7
seoTitle: 48 Moyola Park, Newcastle, Galway City, H91KWX7
description:
O'Donnellan & Joyce Auctioneers are pleased to offer for sale this substantial detached residence in the popular Moyola Park in the Newcastle area of Galway City.

The property consists of spacious accommodation with approximately 155.7 sq. m & offers excellent potential throughout.

The ground floor is arranged between two large adjacent reception rooms, a dining area which leads to the kitchen area that overlooks the private garden and is completed via an adjacent utility space. 

Upstairs is arranged via four sizeable bedrooms, all with fitted storage & one availing of its own W.C., and a main family bathroom.

Furthermore, 48 Moyola Park benefits from a self-contained unit with its own private side entrance and consists of a kitchenette, W.C, shower room & its own bedroom.  This space could easily be re-integrated into the home or be utilised as a quality investment opportunity.

A key feature of no. 48 Moyola Park is the outside space on offer.  The front of the property currently offers off-street parking for two vehicles, along with a manicured lawn & hedge frontage, as well as overlooking one of the communal greens.

The private rear garden is an impressive area with an abundance of space & encompassed by mature greenery.

Moyola Park is a long established & popular residential area of Newcastle, Galway City.  The residential estate offers plentiful communal green space & is within walking distance of Galway University, UCHG, Dangan Sportsgrounds & Galway City Centre.

Additionally, all amenities & services are within easy reach as expected from the locale.  The area is a popular family location given the proximity to quality local schools.

No. 48 Moyola Park is an impressive property offering huge potential.

Viewing is highly recommended.
